coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: A scheme-specific challenge whose answer can sustain, qualify, or defeat the defeasible inference.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Scheme Critical Question

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Checks whether the asserted resemblance holds.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Claimed Similarity Question

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Tests whether another relevant comparison supports a conflicting conclusion.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Is there a stronger counteranalogy?

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Tests whether a material disanalogy defeats or narrows the proposed transfer.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Is there a relevant difference between the cases?

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Tests whether the similarities support the transferred property rather than merely resembling the target superficially.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Are the cited similarities relevant to the conclusion?

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Tests the truth and scope of the case from which the conclusion is transferred.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Is the source case itself established?

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Challenges the evidence supporting the causal generalisation.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Causal Evidence Question

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Checks factors counteracting the predicted effect.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Causal Interference Question

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Challenges the causal generalisation's strength.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Causal Strength Question

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Challenges evidence linking action and consequence.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Consequence Evidence Question

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Challenges the predicted consequence's likelihood.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Consequence Likelihood Question

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Checks consequences carrying opposing value.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Opposite Consequences Question

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Checks whether the example supports the generalisation.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Example Instantiation Question

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Challenges the generalisation's strength and applicability.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Generalisation Strength Question

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Checks the example's attributed properties.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Example Truth Question

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Checks representativeness within the generalisation's scope.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Example Typicality Question

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Tests whether the argument preserves the source's actual proposition, scope, and qualification.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: What exactly did the source assert?

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Tests whether credible peers materially disagree and whether that disagreement changes the presumption.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Is the assertion consistent with other qualified opinion?

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Tests the data, method, or reasons behind the opinion rather than relying on status alone.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Is the assertion supported by evidence?

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Tests the source's qualifications, experience, and standing for this subject.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: How credible is the source as an expert?

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Tests whether the proposition actually falls inside the expertise established for the source.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Is the assertion within the source's field?

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Tests bias, conflicts, incentives, and reporting conditions relevant to the assertion.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Is the source trustworthy in this instance?

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Tests whether the informant can know the relevant facts.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Access to Knowledge

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Tests whether the informant actually made the attributed assertion.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Assertion Verification

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Tests the informant's honesty and trustworthiness.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Informant Reliability

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Tests whether another means can realize the goal, before comparing which option is preferable.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Alternative Means Question

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Tests whether another feasible action advances the goal with a more favourable trade-off.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Is there a materially better alternative action?

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Tests material side effects, risks, and conflicts with other goals before accepting the recommendation.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Do adverse consequences outweigh the expected benefit?

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Tests whether the actor can perform the proposed action under the stated constraints.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Is the proposed action feasible?

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Tests the strength and scope of the means–goal connection rather than assuming it from sequence or plausibility.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Will the action advance the goal?

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Tests whether the stated goal is an appropriate objective for the actual decision and audience.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Is the goal legitimate and genuinely valued?

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Challenges the indicator's evidential strength.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Sign Correlation Strength Question

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Challenges whether the classification premise is sufficiently strong or remains doubtful.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Classification Strength Question

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Challenges whether the entity has the property asserted in the individual premise.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Individual Property Question

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: A named semantic role that an instantiated scheme must bind to actual argument components or support sets.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Scheme Premise Slot

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: States the similarities that are material to the transferred conclusion rather than merely superficial.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Analogy Relevant-Similarity Premise

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: States the cited case from which the proposed inference is transferred.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Analogy Source-Case Premise

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: States the case to which the proposed inference is applied.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Analogy Target-Case Premise

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: States the defeasible cause-effect connection.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Causal Generalisation Premise

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Asserts the example's relevant properties.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Example Instance Premise

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Records the exact proposition the qualified source asserts.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Expert Opinion Assertion Premise

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Establishes the source's relevant expertise in the field to which the proposition belongs.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Expert Opinion Expertise Premise

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Establishes that the asserted proposition falls within the source's relevant field.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Expert Opinion Field Premise

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Asserts widespread acceptance of the proposition.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Popular Opinion Acceptance Premise

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Records what the informant asserts.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Position to Know Assertion

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: States the concrete action proposed as a means of advancing the goal.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Practical Reasoning Action Premise

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: States the goal or audience-valued outcome the proposed action is intended to advance.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Practical Reasoning Goal Premise

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: States the warranted connection by which the proposed action advances the declared goal.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Practical Reasoning Means–Goal Premise

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Supplies the defeasible connection from indicator A to proposition B in the relevant kind of situation.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Sign Indicator Warrant

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Asserts that the indicator A occurs in the situation under consideration.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Sign Observation Premise

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Identifies the unacceptable endpoint of the sequence.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Slippery Slope Bad Outcome

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Identifies the initially proposed action.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Slippery Slope First Step

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Claims successive plausible transitions from the initial step.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Slippery Slope Recursive Premise

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: A defeasible inference pattern whose presumption is assessable only with its declared premise slots and critical questions.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Argumentation Scheme

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Challenges a person's argument through an adverse allegation about that person; the allegation's relevance must itself be justified.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Ad Hominem Argument

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Transfers a defeasible conclusion from a cited source case to a target case on the basis of relevant similarities and after testing relevant differences.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Argument from Analogy

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Predicts an effect defeasibly from an asserted cause and a causal generalisation.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Argument from Cause to Effect

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Recommends or opposes an action by evaluating its anticipated consequences.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Argument from Consequences

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Infers a generalisation defeasibly from a particular case or collection of cases.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Argument from Example

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Reasons defeasibly from a qualified source's assertion in its field to acceptance of the asserted proposition.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Argument from Expert Opinion

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Invokes widespread acceptance as a defeasible reason to accept a proposition.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Argument from Popular Opinion

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Accepts an assertion presumptively because its source has access to the relevant facts.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Argument from Position to Know

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Reasons from a desired goal and a feasible action that promotes it to a defeasible recommendation to perform that action.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Argument from Practical Reasoning

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Infers a state of affairs from an observed indicator associated with it.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Argument from Sign

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Opposes an initial step because a claimed sequence of transitions would lead to an unacceptable outcome.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Slippery Slope Argument

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Assigns an individual to a category through an attributed property and a classification rule.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Argument from Verbal Classification

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: A parameter of an inference pattern, distinct from a premise asserting a relationship among parameters.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Scheme Variable

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: The proposition transferred between compared cases.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Analogy Transferred Proposition

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: The initiating event in the causal inference.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Cause Variable

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: The predicted event in the causal inference.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Effect Variable

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: The proposed action assessed through its consequences.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Consequences Action Variable

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: The subject domain S to which the expertise and proposition are related; naming it does not establish the required field relationship.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Expert Opinion Domain Variable

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: The source E whose expertise and assertion are at issue; identifying E alone does not establish expertise.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Expert Opinion Source Variable

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: The proposition whose widespread acceptance supports a presumption.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Popular Opinion Proposition

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: The informant whose access to the facts is questioned.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Position to Know Source

coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.description: Proposition B whose truth is inferred from the observed sign, rather than independently assumed as a premise.
coe:concept/argumentation_schemes_taxono.label: Sign Indicated Proposition Variable

coe:artifact/narrative/argumentation_sch.description: Canonical identities for the bounded Walton-style defeasible reasoning patterns, together with the premise-slot and critical-question identities required to instantiate and challenge each pattern without treating its conclusion as deductively proven.

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/app.description: Downstream NLP task that consumes parsed discourse structures as input features.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/app.label: application_domain

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/app.description: Summarization that generates new phrasing rather than selecting source spans, using discourse structure to judge content salience (standard NLP task)
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/app.label: Abstractive Summarization

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/app.description: Automatic extraction of claims, premises, and their support and attack relations, for which parsed discourse relations provide structural scaffolding (standard NLP task)
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/app.label: Argument Mining

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/app.description: Identifying a text's author from stylistic patterns, with habitual discourse-structuring choices serving as discriminating features (standard NLP task)
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/app.label: Authorship Attribution

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/app.description: Scoring how well a text hangs together, using the parsed relation structure itself as the coherence signal (standard NLP task)
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/app.label: Coherence Evaluation

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/app.description: Detecting deceptive text from linguistic cues, including atypical discourse structuring relative to truthful writing (standard NLP task)
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/app.label: Deception Detection

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/app.description: Summarization by selecting spans verbatim from the source, exploiting nuclearity-based deterministic tree pruning to decide which units survive
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/app.label: Extractive Summarization

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/app.description: Answering natural-language questions over text, using discourse relations to locate the spans that bear the answer (standard NLP task)
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/app.label: Question Answering

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/app.description: Classification of evaluative polarity in text, with discourse structure enabling sentiment propagation through hierarchical weighting of spans
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/app.label: Sentiment Analysis

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/dis.description: Major computational discourse theories with distinct topological structures, scope, and recursion handling.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/dis.label: discourse_framework

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/dis.description: Enhanced RST augments a primary rhetorical tree with secondary relations and anchored discourse signals, allowing additional relations to be represented without replacing the primary tree.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/dis.label: eRST

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/dis.description: The Penn Discourse Treebank annotates argument pairs, relation types and senses for explicit and implicit discourse relations, without requiring a single document-wide discourse tree.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/dis.label: PDTB

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/dis.description: Mann and Thompson's Rhetorical Structure Theory — highly recursive projective trees capturing global document structure, whose strict tree constraints force concurrent relations to be discarded
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/dis.label: RST

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/dis.description: Segmented Discourse Representation Theory represents discourse constituents and their semantic and pragmatic relations, including complex constituents and constraints on accessible attachment sites.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/dis.label: SDRT

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/nuc.description: Structural configuration indicating relative semantic weight between spans. Determines which span carries the core communicative intent.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/nuc.label: nuclearity_configuration

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/nuc.description: Multinuclear configuration in which two or more spans carry equal semantic weight with no subordination (Mann & Thompson 1988)
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/nuc.label: Nucleus Nucleus

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/nuc.description: Hypotactic configuration in which the nucleus precedes its supporting satellite, the nucleus carrying the core communicative intent (Mann & Thompson 1988)
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/nuc.label: Nucleus Satellite

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/nuc.description: Hypotactic configuration in which the satellite precedes the nucleus it supports, delaying the span that carries the core communicative intent (Mann & Thompson 1988)
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/nuc.label: Satellite Nucleus

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/par.description: Algorithmic approach for automated discourse tree construction from raw text.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/par.label: parsing_strategy

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/par.description: Shift-reduce approach that iteratively evaluates adjacent units in a working stack, building the tree from leaf EDUs upward — precise at intra-sentential boundaries but sequential, so early errors propagate
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/par.label: Bottom Up

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/par.description: Ensemble approach using an efficient lower-parameter model for segmentation and a highly parameterised reasoning model for relation assignment, optimising both cost and accuracy
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/par.label: Hybrid

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/par.description: Sequential-bisection approach treating the whole document as one macro-span and recursively predicting optimal split points — captures global coherence efficiently but loses precision at fine-grained boundaries
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/par.label: Top Down

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.description: RST-DT rhetorical groups and structural conventions; a coarse group does not fix semantic direction or nuclearity.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.label: relation_class

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.description: RST-DT group for attribution and negative attribution; the satellite supplies the source of the nuclear content.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.label: Attribution

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.description: RST-DT group for background and circumstance, supplying context for interpreting the nucleus.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.label: Background

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.description: RST-DT group for cause, result and consequence; direction depends on the fine label and nuclearity.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.label: Cause

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.description: RST-DT group for comparison, analogy, preference and proportion; members may be mononuclear or multinuclear.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.label: Comparison

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.description: RST-DT group for condition, hypothetical, contingency and otherwise, distinguishing unrealized conditions, hypothetical scenarios, recurrence and alternatives.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.label: Condition

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.description: RST-DT group containing multinuclear contrast and mononuclear concession and antithesis; group membership does not determine nuclearity.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.label: Contrast

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.description: RST-DT group for additional detail, general-specific, part-whole, process-step, object-attribute and set-member elaboration, example and definition.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.label: Elaboration

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.description: RST-DT group containing enablement and purpose, distinguishing facilitation of an unrealized situation from an intended goal.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.label: Enablement

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.description: RST-DT group for evaluation, interpretation, conclusion and comment; fine labels and nuclearity locate the assessment or concluding perspective.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.label: Evaluation

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.description: RST-DT group for evidence, explanation-argumentative and reason, distinguishing persuasion, factual explanation and an animate agent's reason for acting.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.label: Explanation

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.description: RST-DT group containing list and disjunction, joining nuclei through enumeration or alternatives.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.label: Joint

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.description: RST-DT group containing manner and means, distinguishing the style of an action from the method used to accomplish a goal.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.label: Manner Means

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.description: RST-DT structural pseudo-relation rejoining interrupted portions of an EDU; multinuclear by annotation convention.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.label: Same Unit

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.description: RST-DT group containing summary and restatement. A summary may occupy nucleus or satellite; restatement reiterates nuclear content in a satellite.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.label: Summary

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.description: RST-DT group containing temporal-before, temporal-after, temporal-same-time, sequence and inverted-sequence; fine labels preserve chronology and nuclearity.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.label: Temporal

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.description: RST-DT structural relation connecting schematically labelled text spans; multinuclear by annotation convention.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.label: Textual Organization

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.description: RST-DT group containing smooth topic drift and sharp topic shift; members may be mononuclear or multinuclear.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.label: Topic Change

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.description: RST-DT group containing problem-solution, question-answer, statement-response, topic-comment, comment-topic and rhetorical-question; fine labels distinguish roles and direction.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/rel.label: Topic Comment

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/sch.description: Engineering pattern for representing and assembling discourse structures extracted from model outputs.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/sch.label: schema_extraction_pattern

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/sch.description: Represent nested tree nodes directly through recursive schema references; support and depth constraints depend on the selected output system.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/sch.label: Direct Recursive

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/sch.description: Represent nodes and rhetorical edges as separate lists with explicit endpoint references, then reconstruct and validate the hierarchy locally.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/sch.label: Flat Relational Adjacency

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/sch.description: Parse local subtrees separately and link their roots in a later pass; cross-chunk relations and the assembled structure require validation.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/sch.label: Progressive Chunking

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/sig.description: Five distinct categories of discourse signals that indicate rhetorical relations, ranging from explicit lexical markers, a minority of relations, to implicit semantic, syntactic, morphological, and graphical cues that carry the majority.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/sig.label: signal_typology

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/sig.description: Explicit lexical connectives that directly name a rhetorical relation — the most studied signal type, yet accounting for only a minority of discourse relations
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/sig.label: Discourse Marker

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/sig.description: Signals derived from visual and typographic features of the text — punctuation boundaries, paragraph breaks, and section headings
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/sig.label: Graphical

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/sig.description: Signals derived from word-form variation, chiefly verb-tense shifts and person-marker changes between adjacent EDUs
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/sig.label: Morphological

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/sig.description: Signals derived from meaning-level relationships between lexical items across EDUs — lexical chains, synonymy, meronymy, and coreference; the largest signal category
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/sig.label: Semantic

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/sig.description: Signals derived from grammatical constructions and clause-structure patterns such as parallelism, relative clauses, clause mood, and reported speech
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/sig.label: Syntactic

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/tre.description: The graph-theoretic structure used to represent discourse relations.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/tre.label: tree_topology

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/tre.description: A primary tree augmented by secondary cross-branch edges that capture concurrent relations without abandoning the hierarchy — the topology of eRST
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/tre.label: Augmented Graph

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/tre.description: Graph structure permitting multi-parent dependencies and crossing edges while remaining acyclic — the topology of SDRT
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/tre.label: Directed Acyclic Graph

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/tre.description: Relations represented as argument pairs without imposing a single global tree; argument spans need not be adjacent.
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/tre.label: Flat Pairs

coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/tre.description: Strict single-parent tree with no crossing edges — the topology of classical RST
coe:concept/descriptive_rst_taxonomy/tre.label: Projective Tree

coe:artifact/narrative/descriptive_rst_t.description: Classification system for RST rhetorical relations, discourse signal typologies, parsing strategies, tree topologies, and comparative discourse frameworks.

coe:concept/dung_semantics/acceptable.description: An argument whose every attacker is attacked by the evaluating set.
coe:concept/dung_semantics/acceptable.label: Acceptable Argument

coe:concept/dung_semantics/admissible.description: A conflict-free set defending all its members.
coe:concept/dung_semantics/admissible.label: Admissible Set

coe:concept/dung_semantics/argument.description: An abstract item whose internal reasoning is left unspecified.
coe:concept/dung_semantics/argument.label: Argument

coe:concept/dung_semantics/attack.description: A directed challenge from one argument to another.
coe:concept/dung_semantics/attack.label: Attack

coe:concept/dung_semantics/characteristi.description: Maps an argument set to all arguments acceptable relative to it.
coe:concept/dung_semantics/characteristi.label: Characteristic Function

coe:concept/dung_semantics/complete.description: An admissible set containing every argument it defends.
coe:concept/dung_semantics/complete.label: Complete Extension

coe:concept/dung_semantics/conflict_free.description: An argument set containing no internal attack.
coe:concept/dung_semantics/conflict_free.label: Conflict-free Set

coe:concept/dung_semantics/grounded.description: The least fixed point of the characteristic function.
coe:concept/dung_semantics/grounded.label: Grounded Extension

coe:concept/dung_semantics/preferred.description: An admissible set maximal under set inclusion.
coe:concept/dung_semantics/preferred.label: Preferred Extension

coe:concept/dung_semantics/stable.description: A conflict-free set attacking every argument outside itself.
coe:concept/dung_semantics/stable.label: Stable Extension

coe:artifact/narrative/dung_semantics.description: Attack-based acceptability and extension semantics; support edges and internal premise structure are not part of this formalism.

coe:concept/gum_erst_groups/adversative.description: GUM group for antithesis, concession and contrast.
coe:concept/gum_erst_groups/adversative.label: adversative

coe:concept/gum_erst_groups/attribution.description: GUM group for positive and negative attribution.

coe:concept/gum_erst_groups/causal.description: GUM group for cause and result.
coe:concept/gum_erst_groups/causal.label: causal

coe:concept/gum_erst_groups/context.description: GUM group for background and circumstance.
coe:concept/gum_erst_groups/context.label: context

coe:concept/gum_erst_groups/elaboration.description: GUM group for additional detail and attributes.
coe:concept/gum_erst_groups/elaboration.label: elaboration

coe:concept/gum_erst_groups/explanation.description: GUM group for evidence, justification and motivation.
coe:concept/gum_erst_groups/explanation.label: explanation

coe:concept/gum_erst_groups/joint.description: GUM group for list, disjunction, sequence and otherwise unclassified coordination.
coe:concept/gum_erst_groups/joint.label: joint

coe:concept/gum_erst_groups/mode.description: GUM group for manner and means.
coe:concept/gum_erst_groups/mode.label: mode

coe:concept/gum_erst_groups/organization.description: GUM group for heading, preparation and phatic material.
coe:concept/gum_erst_groups/organization.label: organization

coe:concept/gum_erst_groups/purpose.description: GUM group for goals and attribute purposes.
coe:concept/gum_erst_groups/purpose.label: purpose

coe:artifact/narrative/gum_erst_groups.description: Coarse groupings of the GUM and GENTLE relation inventory. A group does not identify a fine relation or determine its nuclearity.

coe:concept/gum_erst_relations/adversati.description: Satellite is less credible than nucleus.
coe:concept/gum_erst_relations/adversati.label: adversative-antithesis

coe:concept/gum_erst_relations/adversati.description: Writer accepts satellite despite claiming nucleus.
coe:concept/gum_erst_relations/adversati.label: adversative-concession

coe:concept/gum_erst_relations/attributi.description: Satellite denies a source for nucleus.
coe:concept/gum_erst_relations/attributi.label: attribution-negative

coe:concept/gum_erst_relations/explanati.description: Satellite motivates the reader's nuclear action.
coe:concept/gum_erst_relations/explanati.label: explanation-motivation

coe:concept/gum_erst_relations/organizat.description: Satellite maintains interaction without substantive content.
coe:concept/gum_erst_relations/organizat.label: organization-phatic

coe:concept/gum_erst_relations/purpose_a.description: Satellite gives a nucleus phrase's purpose.
coe:concept/gum_erst_relations/purpose_a.label: purpose-attribute

coe:concept/gum_erst_relations/same_unit.description: Structural device joining interrupted EDU fragments; not a rhetorical relation.
coe:concept/gum_erst_relations/same_unit.label: same-unit

coe:concept/gum_erst_relations/topic_que.description: Satellite requests information supplied by nucleus.
coe:concept/gum_erst_relations/topic_que.label: topic-question

coe:artifact/narrative/gum_erst_relation.description: Corpus-scoped fine labels, including the same-unit structural convention. Nucleus and satellite refer to rhetorical organization, not source order. These meanings do not define RST-DT labels or model-class indices.

coe:concept/ibis_vocabulary/argument.description: A reason supporting or opposing a position.
coe:concept/ibis_vocabulary/argument.label: Argument

coe:concept/ibis_vocabulary/generalizes.description: Connects an issue to a more specific issue it subsumes.
coe:concept/ibis_vocabulary/generalizes.label: Generalizes

coe:concept/ibis_vocabulary/is_suggested.description: Connects an issue to the deliberation node that prompted it.
coe:concept/ibis_vocabulary/is_suggested.label: Is-suggested-by

coe:concept/ibis_vocabulary/issue.description: A question or problem requiring deliberation.
coe:concept/ibis_vocabulary/issue.label: Issue

coe:concept/ibis_vocabulary/objects_to.description: Connects an opposing argument to a position.
coe:concept/ibis_vocabulary/objects_to.label: Objects-to

coe:concept/ibis_vocabulary/position.description: A proposed resolution of an issue.
coe:concept/ibis_vocabulary/position.label: Position

coe:concept/ibis_vocabulary/questions.description: Connects an issue to the deliberation node it challenges.
coe:concept/ibis_vocabulary/questions.label: Questions

coe:concept/ibis_vocabulary/replaces.description: Connects an issue to the issue it supersedes.
coe:concept/ibis_vocabulary/replaces.label: Replaces

coe:concept/ibis_vocabulary/responds_to.description: Connects a proposed position to its issue.
coe:concept/ibis_vocabulary/responds_to.label: Responds-to

coe:concept/ibis_vocabulary/specializes.description: Connects an issue to a broader issue it narrows.
coe:concept/ibis_vocabulary/specializes.label: Specializes

coe:concept/ibis_vocabulary/supports.description: Connects a favourable argument to a position.
coe:concept/ibis_vocabulary/supports.label: Supports

coe:artifact/narrative/ibis_vocabulary.description: Core issue-based deliberation nodes and the rhetorical links in the gIBIS grammar. Escape nodes and implementation workflow are excluded.

coe:concept/pdtb3_relation_types/entrel.description: Entity coherence without a discourse sense.
coe:concept/pdtb3_relation_types/entrel.label: EntRel

coe:concept/pdtb3_relation_types/norel.description: No annotated discourse or entity relation.
coe:concept/pdtb3_relation_types/norel.label: NoRel

coe:artifact/narrative/pdtb3_relation_ty.description: Annotation kinds distinguish how a discourse connection is expressed, including non-sense-bearing annotations.

coe:concept/pdtb3_senses/cause_negative_.description: Arg1 prevents the effect in Arg2.
coe:concept/pdtb3_senses/cause_negative_.label: Contingency.Cause.NegResult

coe:concept/pdtb3_senses/concession_spee.description: Arg2 denies Arg1's implicit speech act.
coe:concept/pdtb3_senses/concession_spee.label: Comparison.Concession+SpeechAct.Arg2-as-denier+SpeechAct

coe:concept/pdtb3_senses/condition_speec.description: A condition licenses an implicit speech act.
coe:concept/pdtb3_senses/condition_speec.label: Contingency.Condition+SpeechAct

coe:concept/pdtb3_senses/conjunction.description: Arguments contribute together to another situation.
coe:concept/pdtb3_senses/conjunction.label: Expansion.Conjunction

coe:concept/pdtb3_senses/equivalence.description: Arguments describe the same situation differently.
coe:concept/pdtb3_senses/equivalence.label: Expansion.Equivalence

coe:concept/pdtb3_senses/negative_condit.description: Nonoccurrence licenses an implicit speech act.
coe:concept/pdtb3_senses/negative_condit.label: Contingency.Negative-condition+SpeechAct

coe:concept/pdtb3_senses/temporal_synchr.description: The argument situations overlap in time.
coe:concept/pdtb3_senses/temporal_synchr.label: Temporal.Synchronous

coe:artifact/narrative/pdtb3_senses.description: Published PDTB sense distinctions with argument direction and pragmatic qualifiers preserved. This vocabulary is distinct from the smaller discourse-argumentation profile.

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/analogy.description: Transfers a comparison across otherwise different cases.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/analogy.label: analogy

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/attribution.description: Satellite identifies the source of nuclear content.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/attribution.label: attribution

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/attribution.description: Satellite negates attribution of nuclear content.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/attribution.label: attribution-n

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/background.description: Satellite supplies interpretive context without causing nucleus.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/background.label: background

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/cause_resul.description: Equally salient nuclei express cause and effect.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/cause_resul.label: cause-result

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/comment.description: Satellite comments from an external perspective.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/comment.label: comment

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/concession.description: Nucleus violates an expectation raised by satellite.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/concession.label: concession

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/conclusion.description: A concluding judgment wraps up another span.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/conclusion.label: conclusion

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/consequence.description: Spans express an indirect causal connection.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/consequence.label: consequence

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/consequence.description: Nucleus is an indirect consequence of satellite.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/consequence.label: consequence-n

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/consequence.description: Satellite is an indirect consequence of nucleus.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/consequence.label: consequence-s

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/contingency.description: Satellite supplies a recurrent or habitual contingency.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/contingency.label: contingency

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/contrast.description: Equally salient nuclei oppose each other.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/contrast.label: contrast

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/elaboration.description: Satellite specifies a general nuclear concept.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/elaboration.label: elaboration-general-specific

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/elaboration.description: Satellite supplies an essential nuclear attribute.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/elaboration.label: elaboration-object-attribute

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/elaboration.description: Satellite describes a part of nucleus.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/elaboration.label: elaboration-part-whole

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/elaboration.description: Satellite describes steps of the nuclear process.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/elaboration.label: elaboration-process-step

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/elaboration.description: Satellite describes members of a specified set.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/elaboration.label: elaboration-set-member

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/example.description: Satellite exemplifies an incompletely specified set.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/example.label: example

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/explanation.description: Satellite factually explains nucleus without persuasive intent.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/explanation.label: explanation-argumentative

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/hypothetica.description: Nucleus follows from a conjectured satellite.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/hypothetica.label: hypothetical

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/interpretat.description: A span subjectively interprets another span.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/interpretat.label: interpretation

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/manner.description: Satellite describes the manner of nucleus.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/manner.label: manner

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/otherwise.description: Realizing nucleus prevents the alternative satellite.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/otherwise.label: otherwise

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/problem_sol.description: Spans express a problem and solution.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/problem_sol.label: problem-solution

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/question_an.description: Spans express a question and answer.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/question_an.label: question-answer

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/reason.description: A span explains an animate agent's action.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/reason.label: reason

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/rhetorical_.description: Satellite poses a rhetorical question about nucleus.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/rhetorical_.label: rhetorical-question

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/same_unit.description: Structural convention joining interrupted EDU fragments.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/same_unit.label: same-unit

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/span.description: Structural link carrying nuclear content upward.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/span.label: span

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/statement_r.description: Spans express a statement and response.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/statement_r.label: statement-response

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/textualorga.description: Structural convention connecting schematically labelled spans.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/textualorga.label: textualorganization

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/topic_drift.description: Topic changes smoothly with shared focus.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/topic_drift.label: topic-drift

coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/topic_shift.description: Topic changes sharply to different focus.
coe:concept/rst_dt_relations/topic_shift.label: topic-shift

coe:artifact/narrative/rst_dt_relations.description: Corpus-specific relation names and directional variants from Carlson and Marcu. Nuclearity is recorded separately; embedded suffixes identify embedding, not new meanings. Structural conventions remain distinguished in their definitions.

coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/alternation.description: Presents disjunctive alternatives without asserting either constituent.
coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/alternation.label: Alternation

coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/attribution.description: Relates an agent to attributed content without committing to the content's truth.
coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/attribution.label: Attribution

coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/background.description: Supplies contextual information about an event or object; event-state background overlaps temporally.
coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/background.label: Background

coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/cdu.description: A group of discourse constituents interpreted together as a discourse unit.
coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/cdu.label: Complex Discourse Unit

coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/commentary.description: Adds an evaluation or opinion about the first constituent.
coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/commentary.label: Commentary

coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/consequence.description: Relates conditional antecedent to consequent without asserting either constituent.
coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/consequence.label: Consequence

coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/continuation.description: Adds a contribution at the same discourse level under a shared topic.
coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/continuation.label: Continuation

coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/contrast.description: Juxtaposes comparable constituents through opposition or denial of an expected consequence.
coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/contrast.label: Contrast

coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/coordinating.description: Connects constituents at the same level of discourse structure.
coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/coordinating.label: Coordinating Relation

coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/edu.description: An elementary segment contributing a discourse representation.
coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/edu.label: Elementary Discourse Unit

coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/elaboration.description: Develops a constituent through more specific information about its content.
coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/elaboration.label: Elaboration

coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/explanation.description: Provides an explanatory cause for the preceding constituent's situation.
coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/explanation.label: Explanation

coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/narration.description: Relates successive events belonging to a coherent narrative sequence.
coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/narration.label: Narration

coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/parallel.description: Relates constituents through corresponding semantic structure.
coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/parallel.label: Parallel

coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/precondition.description: Presents an event preceding the first constituent; this is reverse narration, not a logical conditional.
coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/precondition.label: Precondition

coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/result.description: Presents a consequence of the preceding constituent's situation.
coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/result.label: Result

coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/right_fronti.description: Restricts incremental attachment to the latest constituent and its available structural superordinates.
coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/right_fronti.label: Right Frontier Constraint

coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/source.description: Relates communicated content to its source; both constituents are treated as veridical.
coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/source.label: Source

coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/subordinatin.description: Connects a constituent to one elaborating or explaining it at a subordinate level.
coe:concept/sdrt_vocabulary/subordinatin.label: Subordinating Relation

coe:artifact/narrative/sdrt_vocabulary.description: Structural concepts and named relations in the DISCOR annotation manual. Other SDRT annotation profiles may differ; this vocabulary does not prescribe a universal relation-to-attachment classification.
